# What does this shipment actually cost, landed?

> Free landed cost calculator for small importers: item cost, freight, duty and Section 301 tariff give cost per unit, with CBP MPF and HMF fees included.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
